children: CDW entered into an underwriting agreement to issue $1.5 billion of senior notes in a registered public offering. The deal includes $600 million of 5.700% notes due 2029, $500 million of 6.100% notes due 2032, and $400 million of 6.350% notes due 2033. The offering, led by BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan Securities, Mizuho Securities USA, and Wells Fargo Securities as representatives of the underwriters, is expected to close on September 21, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The transaction is intended to raise debt financing and enhance liquidity.
